limitations: Development tests and live smoke do not establish holdout language or address precision/recall.
No reviewed local-alias dataset for a real operating area is bundled; live excludes fixture aliases.
Electric motorbike defaults disabled until operational tariff/profile/capacity/child policy is configured.
Fares and bookings are sandbox; no driver dispatch, OTP/payment, scheduled bookings, multiple stops or amendments.
One runtime/process per business/checkpoint database pair; text and HTTP use separate pairs.
Open-Meteo free endpoint is for non-commercial use; configured customer key selects the paid endpoint.
V2 live subset does not claim a complete live create/cancel flow; these paths have offline regression and browser coverage.
